# FreeImage 3.18.0 source notices

The files listed in PROVENANCE.json come from the SHA-256-pinned FreeImage source
ZIP. Original bytes and paths are preserved. Two initial header comments are
stored under extracted-notices with source hashes and byte intervals.

Falco's base lock selects FreeImage Public License 1.0 for FreeImage itself.
Bundled codecs have separate terms. Preserved license alternatives, including
LibRaw's CDDL/LGPL files, are not a blanket license choice for FalcoEngine.
Complete linked-code coverage, source availability and modifications obligations
remain subject to the publication review. The checked-in FreeImage patch remains
part of the build recipe and must accompany its corresponding source information.

The manifest records text encoding for rendering; staged files remain byte-exact.
InstallFreeImageNotices.ps1 installs the reviewed inventory beside applications.
